summary: Exposed knife on the island edge and a towel near the range pose immediate injury and fire risks.

hazards.title: Unsecured Knife Near Island Edge
hazards.detail: Carving knife left blade-exposed near counter edge risks severe cut or accidental drop.
fixSteps: Store knife in a wooden block, drawer sheath, or magnetic strip.
Keep sharp blades pushed back away from high-traffic counter edges.

hazards.title: Towel Hung on Oven Handle
hazards.detail: Cloth hanging directly over the oven door can catch heat or pull hot items when opening.
fixSteps: Relocate kitchen towels to a wall hook away from heating appliances.
Avoid draping combustible fabrics across active oven doors.

hazards.title: Loose Cloth Near Cooktop Area
hazards.detail: Fabric towel resting on counter beside cooking zone poses a minor scorch or slip hazard.
fixSteps: Hang drying cloths on a designated rack away from food prep surfaces.
Keep counter zones clear of loose combustible fabrics.
